name: shiftwork_clock_in
description: Shift-work clock-in: schema-validate the checkpoint file and return the brief for the unit at plan.cursor — {unit, role, invariants, handoff, do_not, files} — to hand to the spawned agent verbatim. Structured refusals, never exceptions: result=escalate when handoff.open_questions is non-empty, result=success when every unit is done or dropped, result=error when the checkpoint fails validation.
